revision_reason: Pre-outcome cross-universe support audit showed that module MODULAR and temporal VARIABLE_CONTEXT occur only in U2, while SIMULTANEOUS versus ORDERED timing is replicated in both U2 and U6. U1 is a broad specificity universe with 0/47 source-screen conflict positives. V4 therefore fixes the primary routing model to conflict-focused U2+U6 and uses sampling-universe-specific multinomial intercepts.

external_specificity_and_validation_univ.U1_HAAS_LORTIE_2020: broad interaction specificity / external conflict validation; never injected post hoc into V4 fit

cross_universe_replicated.marginal_support: both timing levels occur in both U2 and U6
cross_universe_replicated.common_support_requirement: at least one module_opportunity2 stratum shared by U2 and U6 must contain >=2 SIMULTANEOUS and >=2 ORDERED_OR_ALTERNATING independent dependence blocks in each universe
cross_universe_replicated.current_common_support: shared module stratum is SINGLE; U2 has SINGLE SIMULTANEOUS=1 and SINGLE ORDERED_OR_ALTERNATING=2, so the strict generality gate is not yet met

support_limited.ceiling: secondary only under current one-block distributed support

registered_interaction_extension.fit_rule: fit only after V4 main model and only when required interaction cells have support; otherwise report non-estimable

reporting_rules: report U2 and U6 architecture-class support separately before pooled V4 results
report temporal SIMULTANEOUS-vs-ORDERED support within each universe and within shared module strata before any generality fit
do not run or interpret the temporal generality sensitivity unless a shared module stratum passes the frozen >=2/level/universe support gate
do not describe module slope as cross-universe generality because MODULAR is U2-only at pre-outcome freeze
report U1 independent reliability outcome separately as specificity validation
spatial exposure remains secondary unless prospectively supported by >=2 DISTRIBUTED dependence blocks

temporal_generality_sensitivity.rationale: SIMULTANEOUS and ORDERED_OR_ALTERNATING are the only two predictor levels represented independently in both U2 and U6 at the pre-outcome freeze.
temporal_generality_sensitivity.fit_gate: requires marginal timing replication AND at least one shared module-opportunity stratum with >=2 independent SIMULTANEOUS and >=2 ORDERED_OR_ALTERNATING blocks in each U2 and U6
interpretation: report universe-specific predicted-probability contrast ORDERED minus SIMULTANEOUS
report U6-vs-U2 interaction posterior for each non-reference architecture logit
cross-universe generality language requires compatible direction and no practically large contradictory interaction
temporal_generality_sensitivity.claim_rule: do not call timing universal solely because the common-slope V4 main model is nonzero
